packageRules.description: Pin Bun to 1.4.4: the first release whose bundled root certificates drop the compromised eMudhra roots (NSS 3.131.1, oven-sh/bun#46300), and the version every workflow builds with. 1.3.12 broke macOS binary codesign for bun build --compile (hotfixed in v0.17.9). Unpin only after verifying signed builds work on the target version.
Do not bump the bun-version input passed to oven-sh/setup-bun to a new minor or major: verify signed macOS builds first. See v0.17.9 hotfix.

Raise a PR for every Bun patch release: Bun ships security fixes in patches (1.4.4 dropped the compromised eMudhra root and blocked its keys), so one is never missed. Its own PR, never automerged, after the 7-day release age.
prBodyNotes: Bun patch release. Before merging: release.yml's smoke-binaries (macOS leg: the signed binary must launch) and the Bun runtime trust gate must pass, and bump BUN_VERSION and TARGET_IMAGE (digest from the registry) in dast.yml by hand.

packageRules.description: Do not propose a new Ubuntu runner (ubuntu-XX.04 in runs-on): a new image changes the toolchain under every job (on ubuntu-26.04, tsc was not found, run 40717887617). Move to one by hand, after a test branch runs the workflows on it.
